stories.title: G20 leaders in London pledge about $1 trillion to fight the crisis

stories.title: Protesters storm Moldova's parliament after a Communist election win
stories.summary: A rerun vote that July brought a pro-European coalition to power.

stories.title: Somali pirates seize the Maersk Alabama; US Navy snipers free its captain
stories.summary: The first hijacking of a US-flagged ship in about two centuries highlighted the piracy surge off Somalia.
stories.unplaced: Off the Somali coast in the Indian Ocean.

stories.title: Red Shirt protesters storm the ASEAN summit in Pattaya
stories.summary: The summit was cancelled and leaders evacuated; the Thaksin-aligned movement went on to its 2010 Bangkok occupation.

stories.title: Russia formally ends its counter-terrorism operation in Chechnya
stories.summary: The end of the Second Chechen War left Ramzan Kadyrov in control; insurgency moved across the North Caucasus.

stories.title: EU launches the Eastern Partnership with six former Soviet states
stories.summary: Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Belarus, Armenia and Azerbaijan were offered association deals, which Moscow saw as an incursion.

stories.title: Pakistan's army launches an offensive to retake Swat from the Pakistani Taliban
stories.summary: Operation Rah-e-Rast followed the collapse of a peace deal; the Taliban there later shot Malala Yousafzai.

stories.title: Sri Lanka's army crushes the Tamil Tigers, ending a 26-year civil war
stories.summary: LTTE leader Velupillai Prabhakaran was killed; a UN panel later said tens of thousands of civilians may have died in the final months.

stories.title: North Korea conducts its second nuclear test
stories.summary: It followed an April rocket launch and UN censure; Pyongyang quit the Six-Party Talks, and the UN tightened sanctions in Resolution 1874.

stories.title: Obama's Cairo speech seeks 'a new beginning' with the Muslim world
stories.summary: The address raised expectations on Palestine and democracy that went largely unmet.

stories.title: Iran declares Ahmadinejad re-elected, and the Green Movement fills the streets
stories.summary: Supporters of Mir-Hossein Mousavi alleged fraud; the crackdown that followed shaped every later protest wave.

stories.title: Brazil, Russia, India and China hold the first BRIC summit in Yekaterinburg
stories.summary: The grouping later added South Africa and became a vehicle for non-Western coordination.

stories.title: Honduran soldiers oust President Manuel Zelaya and fly him out of the country
stories.summary: Zelaya had pushed a poll on rewriting the constitution; the OAS suspended Honduras.
